data.description:
## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- dd-4: Unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic.

## Implementation
Write tests/scripts/test-resolve-feature-flag-approval.sh — a BEHAVIORAL bash suite driving the (not-yet-existent) helper plugins/dso/scripts/implementation-plan/resolve-feature-flag-approval.sh with STUBBED `ticket show` fixtures (PATH-shimmed stub `dso`/`ticket show`), exercising the helper as real code under test — deterministic, no live ticket access. Assert the single-line JSON marker emitted on stdout for each permutation:
1. tag on story -> {"feature-flags":"approved",...,"source":"story"}
2. tag on parent epic -> {"feature-flags":"approved",...,"source":"parent"}
3. tag on neither -> {"feature-flags":"prohibited", reason set, "source":"none"}
4. no parent exists -> safe-default {"feature-flags":"prohibited", reason set}
5. lookup failure (ticket show non-zero/unparseable) -> safe-default {"feature-flags":"prohibited", reason set}
Each prohibited case asserts the reason field is NON-EMPTY (dd-2 contract). Fixtures use the literal tag rollout:feature-flags-approved. Use tests/lib/assert.sh; gate on exit code / FAILED: 0. chmod +x. Register in repo-root .test-index keyed on the helper source path.

## TDD Test Spec
Given a stubbed `ticket show` returning the story with rollout:feature-flags-approved (and separately: tag on parent / neither / no parent / lookup failure); When resolve-feature-flag-approval.sh <story-id> is invoked; Then it prints a single-line JSON marker whose feature-flags field is 'approved' for the two tagged cases and 'prohibited' with a non-empty reason for the three untagged/failure cases, and exits 0.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test_unit) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && $LINT_CMD
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && $FORMAT_CHECK_CMD
- [ ] Test file exists and is executable
  Verify: test -x tests/scripts/test-resolve-feature-flag-approval.sh
- [ ] Suite defines at least five test functions (one per permutation + safe-default)
  Verify: grep -c '^test_' tests/scripts/test-resolve-feature-flag-approval.sh | awk '{exit ($1 < 5)}'
- [ ] Suite asserts a NON-EMPTY reason for the prohibited/safe-default cases
  Verify: grep -qE 'reason' tests/scripts/test-resolve-feature-flag-approval.sh
- [ ] Suite drives the helper as real code via a stubbed ticket show (not a source grep)
  Verify: grep -qE 'resolve-feature-flag-approval\.sh' tests/scripts/test-resolve-feature-flag-approval.sh && grep -qiE 'ticket show|stub|PATH=' tests/scripts/test-resolve-feature-flag-approval.sh
- [ ] Suite registered in repo-root .test-index keyed on the helper source path
  Verify: grep -qF 'plugins/dso/scripts/implementation-plan/resolve-feature-flag-approval.sh:tests/scripts/test-resolve-feature-flag-approval.sh' .test-index
- [ ] RED gate: suite fails before the helper exists
  Verify: { ! test -f plugins/dso/scripts/implementation-plan/resolve-feature-flag-approval.sh; } && { bash tests/scripts/test-resolve-feature-flag-approval.sh; test $? -ne 0; }

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
data.title: RED behavioral suite for resolve-feature-flag-approval.sh (two-hop permutations + safe-default-prohibited)
